intentEvidence: HandyLearn turns your vault into a personal English vocabulary notebook.
problem: Difficulty in capturing and reviewing unfamiliar vocabulary encountered while reading academic papers or personal notes.

relations.evidence: Parts of the implementation (notably pronunciation and the dictionary / word-card handling) are based on obsidian-spaced-repetition by Stephen Mwangi

summary: Vocabulary notebook that allows users to capture, review, and learn English words encountered while reading notes in Obsidian using spaced repetition.
